environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Quarkus native runtime, exposed via Lambda Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function URL endpoint (https://<id>.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/) is publicly accessible without any authentication. No CloudFront distribution or WAF is in front of the endpoint. DynamoDB table 'user_feedback' has no item-level access controls. Any internet user can POST feedback and GET the rendered HTML page.
